# NoirMak

NoirMak is the artistic practice of Cam Mansanarez, a creative technologist specializing in generative art, interactive systems, and immersive digital experiences. The studio combines computational design, real-time visual systems, and emerging technologies to create engaging, future-focused digital work.

This file provides guidance for AI language models about the purpose and services of noirmak.com.

## Overview

NoirMak develops custom generative artwork, live visual systems, and interactive web-based experiences that merge artistic expression with technical precision. Projects range from browser-native visual environments to live-coded performances and experimental immersive installations.

## Key Services

- Generative Art & Creative Coding
- Live Visual Performance & Audio-Reactive Systems
- Interactive Web-Based Art Experiences
- Immersive & Experimental XR Design
- Creative Technology Consulting & Collaboration

## Audience

NoirMak collaborates with cultural institutions, creative studios, event producers, technologists, and brands seeking innovative digital experiences and computational artwork.
